summary: Russian forces launched massive drone and missile strikes across Ukraine targeting retail infrastructure in Kryvyi Rih, Odesa, Dnipro, and Slovyansk, causing dozens of casualties. Ukrainian defenses regained ground near Zakhidne in Donetsk region while Russian units advanced near Novokonstantinovka in Sumy region and liberated Dolynka in Zaporizhzhia region. Ukrainian drones struck Russian oil infrastructure in Krasnodar and Rostov regions, and attacked Belgorod and Kursk border areas.
key_points: Russian Shahed drones and missiles struck shopping centers in Kryvyi Rih, Odesa, Dnipro, and Slovyansk between August 20-25, killing at least 15 and wounding over 130 civilians. (Source: @eRadarrua/107073)
Ukrainian forces restored control near Zakhidne in Donetsk region according to DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23778)
Russian 145th motorized infantry battalion advanced in Sumy region, pushing Ukrainian 5th mechanized brigade from Novokonstantinovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Russian 394th motorized infantry regiment broke through defenses southwest of Rovnoye and liberated Dolynka in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Ukrainian drones attacked Afipsky railway station and oil refinery in Krasnodar region, causing two deaths and damaging 10 houses. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Russian KAB strikes on Kramatorsk residential buildings injured 24 people including a two-month-old infant. (Source: @UkraineNow/83681)

Multiple reactive UAVs (Shaheds) detected heading toward Kyiv, Poltava, Kremenchuk, Mykolaiv, and Sumy regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70978, @mon1tor_ua/70972, @kpszsu/74431, @kpszsu/74437, @kpszsu/74430)
Budanov stated Russian campaign since July targets Ukrainian ports to stop exports, affecting state budget and army resources. (Source: @UkraineNow/83685)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces intensified strikes on Ukrainian civilian and commercial infrastructure across multiple cities, with devastating attacks on shopping centers in Kryvyi Rih, Odesa, Dnipro, and Slovyansk causing mass casualties. Simultaneously, Russian ground forces made tactical gains in Sumy and Zaporizhzhia regions while Ukrainian forces recaptured positions near Zakhidne in Donetsk. Ukrainian long-range drones struck Russian oil facilities in Krasnodar and Rostov regions, marking a significant escalation in energy infrastructure targeting.

points: Ukrainian air defenses engaged multiple Shahed drone waves targeting Kyiv (Darnytskyi district), Poltava, Kremenchuk, Obukhiv, and Sumy regions overnight, with at least two drones reported over Kyiv and reactive UAVs approaching Poltava from the east. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70978, @mon1tor_ua/70972, @kpszsu/74430, @kpszsu/74431)

Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Afipsky railway station and oil refinery in Krasnodar region, killing two and injuring two, damaging at least 10 private houses, and reportedly hitting the Novoshakhtinsk oil refinery in Rostov region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Ukrainian forces restored control near Zakhidne in Donetsk region per DeepState map update, indicating a localized counterattack success. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23778)

Ukrainian strikes reported in Odesa region and Konotop (Sumy region) by Russian-affiliated sources, while explosions occurred in Pavlohrad and industrial zone of Osnovyansky district in Kharkiv. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Ukrainian Territorial Conscription Center personnel detained and transported a handcuffed man, reflecting ongoing mobilization enforcement. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32727)

Ukrainian retail sector continues operating despite systematic attacks; major hits on Aurora mall in Slovyansk (Aug 20), JYSK in Kryvyi Rih (Aug 21), two Epicentr hypermarkets in Odesa (Aug 24), and Karavan mall in Dnipro (Aug 25) caused dozens of casualties and widespread destruction. (Source: @eRadarrua/107073)
Russian forces launched eight KAB guided bomb strikes on residential buildings in Kramatorsk, injuring 24 civilians including a two-month-old infant. (Source: @UkraineNow/83681)
Russian Shahed drones struck Chernihiv, wounding three and hitting critical infrastructure; two drones fell in the city. (Source: @UkraineNow/83681)
Russian UAV attack on Zaporizhzhia wounded three civilians. (Source: @UkraineNow/83681)

Russian 145th motorized infantry battalion of the "North" group advanced near Novokonstantinovka (formerly Pershe Travnya) in Sumy region, displacing Ukrainian 5th separate mechanized brigade after fighting since 2025. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

Russian 394th motorized infantry regiment of the 5th army "Vostok" group broke through defenses southwest of Rovnoye and liberated Dolynka village in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

Russian forces conducted strikes across the Dnieper in Kherson region using aviation, while FPV operators burned equipment in Slavyansk suburbs and fighting continued near Nikanovka and Vasylivka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Russian aircraft-type UAVs attacked Peschanoye village in Belgorod region's Belovsky district, injuring four men and destroying a house and outbuilding. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

Heavy fighting continues near Vasylivka on the Volchansk front in Kharkiv region, with Russian "North" group reporting advances on outskirts of Kazachya Lopana and capturing one serviceman from Ukrainian 58th separate motorized infantry brigade. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Russian offensive from the east continues on Slavyansk front with fighting near Nikanovka; FPV operators active in Slavyansk suburbs. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Units of Russian "Center" group liberated Kucherov Yar settlement in DPR between Druzhkivka and Dobropillia per Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Ukrainian forces restored control near Zakhidne in Donetsk region, per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23778)

Russian strikes targeted retail infrastructure in Slovyansk (Aurora mall, Aug 20) and Kramatorsk (KAB strikes on residential buildings), causing civilian casualties. (Source: @eRadarrua/107073, @UkraineNow/83681)

Reactive UAVs (Shaheds) detected heading toward Sumy from the north, and toward Chernihiv and Poltava regions. (Source: @kpszsu/74430, @eRadarrua/107095)
Russian aircraft-type UAVs attacked Peschanoye in Kursk region's Belovsky district, injuring four men and destroying residential buildings. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

Belgorod region suffered three civilian deaths and at least four injuries in past 24 hours from FPV drone strikes on vehicles and commercial facilities in multiple districts. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Ukrainian strikes reported on Konotop in Sumy region and industrial zone of Osnovyansky district in Kharkiv. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

Reactive UAV from Black Sea waters heading toward Mykolaiv region, then Odesa region. (Source: @kpszsu/74437)

Kherson front sees mutual strikes across Dnieper with Russian aviation employed. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are executing a coordinated campaign of exhaustion against Ukrainian civilian and commercial infrastructure, using mass Shahed drone waves and guided bombs to degrade economic capacity and terrorize urban populations. Simultaneously, Russian ground forces are making incremental gains in Sumy and Zaporizhzhia regions while Ukrainian forces hold and locally counterattack in Donetsk. Ukrainian long-range strikes on Russian oil infrastructure demonstrate growing capability to impose costs on Russian economic war-making. The intensity of air attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions nightly indicates sustained high-tempo operations likely to continue.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian civil defense authorities issued specific warnings for Chernihiv and Poltava residents to avoid large shopping centers due to elevated threat intelligence. The "Brama" project mobilizes citizens to counter disinformation and illegal content. International partners including European defense ministries and media utilize Ukrainian air target mapping data. Finnish President Stubb advocated striking Russian commercial warehouses to pressure negotiations. UK Prime Minister engaged symbolically with Ukrainian troops.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Two Majors summary (ukr_leaks_eng/32720) provides detailed frontline claims including specific unit designations (145th motorized infantry battalion, 394th motorized infantry regiment, 5th separate mechanized brigade) and territorial changes, though as a partisan source requires verification. eRadarrua's retail attack timeline (107073) documents a clear pattern of targeting commercial hubs. Drone tracking channels (mon1tor_ua, kpszsu) provide real-time air threat vectors. DeepState map update confirms Ukrainian tactical success near Zakhidne. Budanov's statement links maritime blockade to battlefield resource constraints.
